title: command_query_register_state
description: Schema for query_register_state command-JSON files written to $STATE_DIR/commands/ by the operator. Polled between iterations by orchestrator.sh main loop via lib/command_dispatch.sh (FUP-0815). READ-ONLY: produces a register-vs-predicates snapshot to commands/<command_id>.response.json (gap counts by status; current iteration; budget cap + spend + override; pending_gate state). Touches NO substrate. additionalProperties:true mirrors the FUP-0734 / FUP-0749 precedent on gate_request.schema.json.

command_type.description: Discriminator. MUST be the literal string 'query_register_state'.

command_id.description: Stable identifier for this command instance. Convention: query_register_state_<iso8601_utc>.

issued_by.description: Identifier of the caller. Convention: 'operator-cc-scribe' for scribe-originated.

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of command issuance.

include_fields.description: Optional projection filter — list of snapshot fields to include in the response. If omitted, all default fields are returned. Recognised values: registry_summary, iteration_index, budget, pending_gate, last_role_call_output_ref.
